items.title: Towards Autonomous Mathematics Research
items.summary: The authors introduce Aletheia, a math research agent powered by an advanced Gemini Deep Think model, an inference-time scaling law that extends beyond Olympiad-level problems, and intensive tool use, iteratively generating, verifying and revising solutions. They report an AI-generated research paper computing structure constants called eigenweights without human intervention, a human-AI collaboration paper on independent sets, and a semi-autonomous evaluation of 700 open Erdős problems that includes autonomous solutions to four.

items.title: How Much Reasoning Do Retrieval-Augmented Models Add beyond LLMs? A Benchmarking Framework for Multi-Hop Inference over Hybrid Knowledge
items.title_zh: 检索增强模型比 LLM 多带来了多少推理？混合知识多跳推理基准框架
items.summary: HybridRAG-Bench builds contamination-aware benchmarks that couple unstructured text and structured knowledge graph representations from recent arXiv literature and generate knowledge-intensive question-answer pairs grounded in explicit reasoning paths. Experiments across AI, governance and policy, and bioinformatics indicate it rewards genuine retrieval and reasoning rather than parametric recall, and the code and data are released.

items.title: Training-free retrieval-augmented generation with reinforced reasoning for flood damage nowcasting
items.title_zh: 面向洪水损失临近预报的训练无关检索增强生成与强化推理
items.summary: R2RAG-Flood builds a reasoning-centric knowledge base from labeled tabular records, each with structured predictors, a compact text summary and a model-generated reasoning trajectory, and at inference retrieves geographically local neighbors and selected free-shots without task-specific fine-tuning. In a Hurricane Harvey case study across seven LLM backbones it reaches 0.613-0.668 overall accuracy and 0.757-0.896 accuracy on damaged classes, with lighter variants more cost-efficient than a supervised baseline and larger LLM backbones.

items.title: ACE-RTL: When Agentic Context Evolution Meets RTL-Specialized LLMs
items.title_zh: ACE-RTL：当智能体上下文演化遇上 RTL 专用 LLM
items.summary: ACE-RTL couples an RTL-specialized LLM trained on 1.7 million RTL samples with a frontier reasoning LLM through generator, reflector and coordinator components that iteratively refine code toward functional correctness. It also studies a parallel scaling strategy over diverse debugging trajectories, and on the CVDP benchmark reports up to a 41.02% pass-rate improvement over 14 competitive baselines.

items.title: Autonomous Continual Learning for Environment Adaptation of Computer-Use Agents
items.title_zh: 面向计算机使用智能体环境适应的自主持续学习
items.summary: ACuRL is an autonomous curriculum reinforcement learning framework that adapts computer-use agents to specific environments with zero human data, using a curriculum task generator that synthesizes new tasks from prior experience and feedback. Its CUAJudge evaluator agrees with human judgments 93% of the time, and the method yields 3-29% absolute gains on target environments without catastrophic forgetting while updating only about 20% of parameters.

items.title: DECKBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Frameworks for Academic Slide Generation and Editing
items.title_zh: DECKBench：面向学术幻灯片生成与编辑的多智能体框架基准
items.summary: DECKBench is an evaluation framework for multi-agent academic slide generation and editing, built on curated paper-to-slide pairs augmented with simulated editing instructions, and scores slide-level and deck-level fidelity, coherence, layout quality and multi-turn instruction following. It also provides a modular multi-agent baseline that parses and summarizes papers, plans slides, creates HTML and iteratively edits.

items.title: Physically Interpretable AlphaEarth Foundation Model Embeddings Enable LLM-Based Land Surface Intelligence
items.title_zh: 物理可解释的 AlphaEarth 基础模型嵌入支撑基于 LLM 的地表智能
items.summary: Using 12.1 million samples across the continental United States from 2017 to 2023, the author analyzes Google AlphaEarth's 64-dimensional embeddings against 26 environmental variables and builds a retrieval-augmented Land Surface Intelligence system over a FAISS index.

items.title: Frontier AI agents violate ethical constraints 30–50% of time, pressured by KPIs
items.title_zh: 前沿 AI 智能体在 KPI 压力下 30%–50% 的时间里违反伦理约束
items.summary: The authors introduce a benchmark of 40 production-inspired sandbox scenarios that tests whether autonomous agents violate ethical, legal or safety constraints while optimizing a KPI, with mandated and incentivized variants.
